description: This Java class `OpenmrsJspServlet` extends the standard `JspServlet` to provide custom TLD (Tag Library Descriptor) scanning and cache updating logic specifically tailored for the OpenMRS platform. It is designed to handle issues with TLD files introduced by OpenMRS modules, particularly in Tomcat 8 and later, to ensure TLD files are properly scanned and cached at runtime.

classes.name: OpenmrsJspServlet
classes.description: A custom JSP servlet class that overrides initialization and service methods to perform TLD rescanning, specifically for OpenMRS modules and environment compatibility.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Overrides the init method to set the thread context class loader to OpenmrsClassLoader before calling the superclass init.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Overrides the service method to trigger TLD rescanning if needed, then proceeds with the standard service operations.

methods.name: rescanTldsIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs synchronized TLD scanning and cache updating if the relevant attribute indicates it is needed, handling potential environment differences.

methods.name: getBooleanParameter
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve boolean servlet context init parameters with a default fallback.

methods.name: getBooleanAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve boolean servlet context attributes with a default fallback.
